title: Types of AI
definition: The classification of AI systems based on their capabilities, typically categorized as Narrow AI (Weak), General AI (Strong), and Superintelligent AI.
simpleExplanation: We categorize AI by how smart it is compared to humans. Right now, we only have Narrow AI (good at one specific task). General AI would be exactly as smart as a human at everything. Superintelligent AI would be vastly smarter than the smartest human.
realWorldExample: Narrow AI: AlphaGo (it can beat the world champion at the board game Go, but it doesn't know how to tie its shoes or make a cup of coffee). General AI: C-3PO from Star Wars.

basic: Does human-level Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) currently exist?

answers.question: Does AGI exist?
answers.answer: No. As of today, all existing AI systems, including powerful models like GPT-4, are strictly classified as 'Narrow AI' because they lack true generalized human reasoning and consciousness.

answers.question: What is ASI?
answers.answer: A hypothetical future point where an AI becomes vastly smarter than the best human brains in practically every field, including scientific creativity, general wisdom, and social skills.
